```{r Prepping}

## Loading packages

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects) # for ggpredict
library(lme4) # for lmer
library(cowplot) # to patch figures together
library(patchwork) # for adding histogram panels into one figure
library(scales) # for making the label number 


## Loading data

  # nest-level data for all cavities
nesting_os <- read_csv('data/nesting_cleaned_osmia.csv')
nesting_meg <- read_csv('data/nesting_cleaned_megachile.csv') 
  # trapnest-level data
trapnesting_os <- read_csv('data/trapnesting_cleaned_osmia.csv')
trapnesting_meg <- read_csv('data/trapnesting_cleaned_megachile.csv')
  # cell-level data
nesting_cells_os <- read_csv('data/nesting_cells_cleaned_osmia.csv')
nesting_cells_meg <- read_csv('data/nesting_cells_cleaned_megachile.csv')
  # nest-level data for investment measures
nesting_investment_os <- read_csv('data/investment_cleaned_osmia.csv')
nesting_investment_meg <- read_csv('data/investment_cleaned_megachile.csv')
  # model for Fig S9 and S10
mod_3aii_choice_consp_par_os_no_ps <- readRDS('Models/mod_3aii_choice_consp_par_os_no_ps.rds')
mod_3aiv_choice_consp_par_meg_no_ps <- readRDS('Models/mod_3aiv_choice_consp_par_meg_no_ps.rds')


# number of nests
nesting_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(Bee_choice)) %>%
  summarize(nests_total = sum(Bee_choice)) # 167 osmia nests for osmia through the summer
nesting_meg %>%
  filter(!is.na(Bee_choice)) %>%
  summarize(nests_total = sum(Bee_choice)) # 140 megachile nests for osmia through the summer

# set theme
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 15))


## Cleaning data to match the data analysed
nesting_os <- nesting_os %>% filter(Year != 'year_2024')
trapnesting_os <- trapnesting_os %>% filter(Year != 'year_2024')
nesting_cells_os <- nesting_cells_os %>% filter(Year != 'year_2024')
nesting_investment_os <- nesting_investment_os %>% filter(Year != 'year_2024')
nesting_os <- nesting_os %>% filter(Site != 'CP')
trapnesting_os <- trapnesting_os %>% filter(Site != 'CP')
nesting_cells_os <- nesting_cells_os %>% filter(Site != 'CP')
nesting_meg <- nesting_meg %>% filter(Site != 'NN')
trapnesting_meg <- trapnesting_meg %>% filter(Site != 'NN')
nesting_cells_meg <- nesting_cells_meg %>% filter(Site != 'NN')



```

```{r Simulations}


## Create the function to simulate data

# simulate the null hypothesis that bees are treating each cavity equally, thus nesting would be based just on availability
# simulation without replacement so that if there are multiple new osmia nests, the number of available cavities goes down by one for each sequential new nest in that subsite-group combo

# create a function to simulate the distribution of nests based on the null hypothesis that bees are nesting according to available cavities 
simulate_nests <- function(avail_cavities, total_nests) {
  n <- length(avail_cavities) # number of available cavities
  nest_counts <- rep(0, n) # start with zero nests in each trapnest

  # keep as zeros is no nests are built
  if (total_nests == 0) {
    return(nest_counts)
  }

  # look through each of the new nests to be randomly assigned
  for (i in 1:total_nests) {
    if (sum(avail_cavities) == 0) break  # stop if all cavities used
    probability <- avail_cavities / sum(avail_cavities) # calculate probability proportional to the number of available cavities
    chosen <- sample(1:n, size = 1, prob = probability) # randomly choose a trapnest for the new nest based on available cavities
    nest_counts[chosen] <- nest_counts[chosen] + 1 # record it
    avail_cavities[chosen] <- avail_cavities[chosen] - 1 # reduce the number of available cavities by 1, when we apply the function the loop will run again until no new nests are left
  }
  return(nest_counts) # return the vector with how many nests were randomly assigned
}

# indicate how many simulated data columns we want for the model
n_sim <- 250 


## Apply the function

trapnesting_os_null <- trapnesting_os %>%
  group_by(Subsite, Date) %>%
  group_modify(~ { # simulate random nest distribution for subsite-date combo
    for (i in 1:n_sim){ # make each of the columns we indicated that we want 
    nest_counts <- simulate_nests(.x$Available_cavities_prior, sum(.x$New_nests_os)) # use available cavities as weights and sum the new nests
    .x[[paste0('Null_new_nests', i)]] <- nest_counts # make the new column
    }
    .x # return the modified group
  }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


## Apply the function

trapnesting_meg_null <- trapnesting_meg %>%
  group_by(Subsite, Date) %>%
  group_modify(~ { # simulate random nest distribution for subsite-date combo
    for (i in 1:n_sim){ # make each of the columns we indicated that we want 
    nest_counts <- simulate_nests(.x$Available_cavities_prior, sum(.x$New_nests_meg)) # use available cavities as weights and sum the new nests
    .x[[paste0('Null_new_nests', i)]] <- nest_counts # make the new column
    }
    .x # return the modified group
  }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


```

```{r Ordering_treatments}


## Ordering treatments
trapnesting_os_null$Treatment <- factor(trapnesting_os_null$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c('Low', 'Mid', 'High'))
trapnesting_meg_null$Treatment <- factor(trapnesting_meg_null$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c('Low', 'Mid', 'High'))

nesting_cells_os$Treatment <- factor(nesting_cells_os$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c('Low', 'Mid', 'High'))
nesting_cells_meg$Treatment <- factor(nesting_cells_meg$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c('Low', 'Mid', 'High'))

## Make mean of null new nests
trapnesting_os_null <- trapnesting_os_null %>% mutate(Null_new_nests_mean = rowMeans(select(., Null_new_nests1:Null_new_nests100)))
trapnesting_meg_null <- trapnesting_meg_null %>% mutate(Null_new_nests_mean = rowMeans(select(., Null_new_nests1:Null_new_nests100)))


```

```{r P1_Congeneric_Attraction}


## Osmia ##

# make proportion of new nests / available cavities
P1_os <- trapnesting_os_null %>% 
  select(Trapnest, Treatment, Date, New_nests_os, Available_cavities_prior, Null_new_nests_mean) %>% 
  group_by(Trapnest, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(sum_New_nests_os = sum(New_nests_os), sum_Available_cavities_prior = sum(Available_cavities_prior), sum_Null_new_nests_mean = sum(Null_new_nests_mean)) 

P1_os <- P1_os %>% 
  group_by(Trapnest, Treatment) %>% 
  summarise(Prop_new_of_avail_obs = (sum_New_nests_os/sum_Available_cavities_prior), Prop_new_of_avail_null = (sum_Null_new_nests_mean/sum_Available_cavities_prior))

# pivot longer
P1_os <- P1_os %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c('Prop_new_of_avail_obs', 'Prop_new_of_avail_null'),
    names_to = 'Data_type',
    values_to = 'Proportion'
  )

# make the mean and error bars
P1_os_sum <- P1_os %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Data_type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Proportion),
    SD = sd(Proportion), 
    SE = SD / sqrt(n()),
    CI_low = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_high = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )


Fig_p1_os <- P1_os_sum %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = Mean, x = Treatment, fill = Data_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = 'dodge') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                width = 0.3,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c('Prop_new_of_avail_null' = '#F0C282',
      'Prop_new_of_avail_obs'  = '#59989e'),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia)),
    breaks = c('Prop_new_of_avail_null', 'Prop_new_of_avail_obs'),
    labels = c('Simulated', 'Observed')
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)



## Megachile ##

# make proportion of new nests / available cavities
P1_meg <- trapnesting_meg_null %>% 
  select(Trapnest, Treatment, Date, New_nests_meg, Available_cavities_prior, Null_new_nests_mean) %>% 
  group_by(Trapnest, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(sum_New_nests_meg = sum(New_nests_meg), sum_Available_cavities_prior = sum(Available_cavities_prior), sum_Null_new_nests_mean = sum(Null_new_nests_mean)) 

P1_meg <- P1_meg %>% 
  group_by(Trapnest, Treatment) %>% 
  summarise(Prop_new_of_avail_obs = (sum_New_nests_meg/sum_Available_cavities_prior), Prop_new_of_avail_null = (sum_Null_new_nests_mean/sum_Available_cavities_prior))

# pivot longer
P1_meg <- P1_meg %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c('Prop_new_of_avail_obs', 'Prop_new_of_avail_null'),
    names_to = 'Data_type',
    values_to = 'Proportion'
  )

# make the mean and error bars
P1_meg_sum <- P1_meg %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Data_type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Proportion),
    SD = sd(Proportion),
    SE = SD / sqrt(n()),
    CI_low = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_high = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

Fig_p1_meg <- P1_meg_sum %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = Mean, x = Treatment, fill = Data_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = 'dodge') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                width = 0.3,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c('Prop_new_of_avail_null' = '#F0C282',
      'Prop_new_of_avail_obs'  = '#B6686B'),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile)),
    breaks = c('Prop_new_of_avail_null', 'Prop_new_of_avail_obs'),
    labels = c('Simulated', 'Observed')
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)


## Combine figures 

# combine and add letters to each panel
combined_p1 <-  Fig_p1_os | Fig_p1_meg + theme(legend.box = 'vertical',
      legend.position = 'right') 
combined_p1 <- combined_p1 +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

# make lengends stack ontop of each other
combined_p1 <- combined_p1 + plot_layout(guides = 'collect') &
  theme(legend.box = 'vertical') 

Fig_p1 <- combined_p1 +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)) 

P1_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Proportion of available cavities newly occupied',
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

P1_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Occupant density treatment',
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# combine them into a single plot object
Fig_p1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(P1_left_label, Fig_p1, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95))
Fig_p1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig_p1, P1_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))

# save
ggsave('Figures/Fig_p1.png', Fig_p1, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# sample size
sum(trapnesting_os_null$New_nests_os) # 161
sum(trapnesting_meg_null$New_nests_meg) # 137


```

```{r P2_Parasite_Attraction}


## Osmia ##

# number of parasitized nests
P2_os <- nesting_cells_os %>% 
  select(Treatment, Trapnest, Nest_ID, Nest_parasitized) %>% 
  arrange(Nest_parasitized, Nest_ID) %>% 
  group_by(Nest_ID) %>% 
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>% # select last row of data
  ungroup()


# count totals
P2_os_sum <- P2_os %>%
  count(Treatment, Trapnest, Nest_parasitized)


# make proportions 
P2_os_sum_v2 <- P2_os_sum %>% 
  group_by(Treatment, Nest_parasitized) %>% 
  summarise(Sum_nests = sum(n))
# pivot wider
P2_os_sum_v2 <- pivot_wider(P2_os_sum_v2, names_from = Nest_parasitized, values_from = Sum_nests)

P2_os_sum_v2 <- P2_os_sum_v2 %>%
  mutate(Prop_par = parasitized / (parasitized + `not parasitized`))


# plot
Fig_p2_os <- P2_os_sum_v2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = Prop_par, x = Treatment)) + 
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge', stat = 'identity', fill = '#59989e') +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
  )
Fig_p2_os


## Megachile ##

# number of parasitized nests
P2_meg <- nesting_cells_meg %>% 
  select(Treatment, Trapnest, Nest_ID, Nest_parasitized) %>% 
  arrange(Nest_parasitized, Nest_ID) %>% 
  group_by(Nest_ID) %>% 
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# count totals
P2_meg_sum <- P2_meg %>%
  count(Treatment, Trapnest, Nest_parasitized)

### try making proportions 
P2_meg_sum_v2 <- P2_meg_sum %>% 
  group_by(Treatment, Nest_parasitized) %>% 
  summarise(Sum_nests = sum(n))
# pivot wider
P2_meg_sum_v2 <- pivot_wider(P2_meg_sum_v2, names_from = Nest_parasitized, values_from = Sum_nests)

P2_meg_sum_v2 <- P2_meg_sum_v2 %>%
  mutate(Prop_par = parasitized / (parasitized + `not parasitized`))


# plot
Fig_p2_meg <- P2_meg_sum_v2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = Prop_par, x = Treatment)) + 
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge', stat = 'identity', fill = '#B6686B') +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5),
    limits = c(0, 0.5)
  )
Fig_p2_meg


## Combine plots


combined_p2 <-  Fig_p2_os | Fig_p2_meg 
combined_p2 <- combined_p2 +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

Fig_p2 <- combined_p2 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = NULL) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)) 

P2_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Proportion of parasitised nests',
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

P2_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Occupant density treatment',
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
  
# add left and bottom labels
Fig_p2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(P2_left_label, combined_p2, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95)) 
Fig_p2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig_p2, P2_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))


# save
ggsave('Figures/Fig_p2.png', Fig_p2, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)


# sample size
table(P2_os$Nest_parasitized) # 27 no, 55 yes
length(unique(nesting_cells_os$Nest_ID)) # 55 + 27 = 82, great match
table(P2_meg$Nest_parasitized) # 42 no, 14 yes
length(unique(nesting_cells_meg$Nest_ID)) # 42 + 14 = 56, perfect

nesting_cells_os %>% 
  filter(Cell_occupant == 'parasite') %>% 
  count(Species_or_subtype, Nest_ID)
# sapyga: 52 / 82 = 63% 
# melittobia: 3 / 82 = 4%
nesting_cells_meg %>% 
  filter(Cell_occupant == 'parasite') %>% 
  count(Species_or_subtype, Nest_ID)
# coelioxys: 6 / 56 = 11%
# chalcid: 3 / 56 = 5%
# meloidae: 3 / 56 = 5%
# melittobia: 2 / 56 = 4%
```

```{r P3a_Parasite_Avoidance}


## Osmia ##

# make binary column for surrounding nests being parasitized or not
trapnesting_os <- trapnesting_os %>% mutate(DP_os_prior_bi = ifelse(DP_os_prior == 0, 0, 1))
trapnesting_os <- trapnesting_os %>% mutate(DP_os_prior_bi = factor(DP_os_prior_bi))
# put 'not parasitized' last so it is drawn on top and make proportion data for figure
trapnesting_os$DP_os_prior_bi <- factor(trapnesting_os$DP_os_prior_bi,
         levels = c("1", "0"))

P3a_os <- trapnesting_os %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = New_nests_os, x = NDP_ps_os_prior)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.09, width = 0.09, alpha = 0.7,
              aes(colour = DP_os_prior_bi,
                  shape  = DP_os_prior_bi)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              aes(colour = DP_os_prior_bi,
                  fill   = DP_os_prior_bi),
                  linetype = "longdash") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c('0' = "#59989e", '1' = "#21393b"),
    labels = c("Present", "Absent"),
    name = bquote(atop("Neighbouring" ~ italic(Osmia) ~ "nests",
                   "with detectable parasites"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c('0' = "#59989e", '1' = "#21393b"),
    labels = c("Present", "Absent"),
    name = bquote(atop("Neighbouring" ~ italic(Osmia) ~ "nests",
                   "with detectable parasites"))) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("0" = 16,
             "1" = 17),
    labels = c("Present", "Absent"),
    name = bquote(atop("Neighbouring" ~ italic(Osmia) ~ "nests",
                   "with detectable parasites"))) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  xlim(0, 15) +
  ylim(-0.5, 5) 

P3a_os


## Megachile ##

# make binary column for surrounding nests being parasitized or not
trapnesting_meg <- trapnesting_meg %>% mutate(DP_meg_prior_bi = ifelse(DP_meg_prior == 0, 0, 1))
trapnesting_meg <- trapnesting_meg %>% mutate(DP_meg_prior_bi = factor(DP_meg_prior_bi))
# put 'not parasitized' last so it is drawn on top and make proportion data for figure
trapnesting_meg$DP_meg_prior_bi <- factor(trapnesting_meg$DP_meg_prior_bi,
         levels = c("1", "0"))

P3a_meg <- trapnesting_meg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = New_nests_meg, x = NDP_ps_meg_prior)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.09, width = 0.09, alpha = 0.6,
              aes(colour = DP_meg_prior_bi,
                  shape  = DP_meg_prior_bi)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              aes(colour = DP_meg_prior_bi,
                  fill   = DP_meg_prior_bi),
                  linetype = "longdash") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c('0' = "#B6686B", '1' = "#422426"),
    labels = c("Present", "Absent"),
    name = bquote(atop("Neighbouring" ~ italic(Megachile) ~ "nests",
                   "with detectable parasites")))   +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c('0' = "#B6686B", '1' = "#422426"),
    labels = c("Present", "Absent"),
    name = bquote(atop("Neighbouring" ~ italic(Megachile) ~ "nests",
                   "with detectable parasites"))) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("0" = 16,
             "1" = 17),
    labels = c("Present", "Absent"),
    name = bquote(atop("Neighbouring" ~ italic(Megachile) ~ "nests",
                   "with detectable parasites")))   +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) + 
  theme(
  legend.title.align = 0
) +
  xlim(0, 15) +
  ylim(-0.5, 5) 

P3a_meg


# Combine 

combined_p3a <- P3a_os + P3a_meg + plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

P3a_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Number of new nests',
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) 

# add left and bottom labels

Fig_p3a <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  combined_p3a,
  cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Number of neighbouring nests with no detectable parasites",
      hjust = 0.75),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09), align = "v", axis = "l")

Fig_p3a <- cowplot::plot_grid(P3a_left_label, Fig_p3a, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95)) 

Fig_p3a

# save
ggsave('Figures/Fig_p3a.png', Fig_p3a, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = 'white')
```

```{r P3b_Investment}

## Osmia ##
# make proportion data for figure
nesting_investment_os <- nesting_investment_os %>% mutate(Prop_filled = Filled_length / Straw_length)

# inspecting the three data points at the end
nesting_investment_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(Nest_parasitized)) %>% filter(DP_os_prior == 3)


# plot
P3b_os <- nesting_investment_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(Nest_parasitized)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(DP_os_prior, Prop_filled)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = binomial()),
    aes(colour = Nest_parasitized,
        fill = Nest_parasitized),
    linetype = "longdash"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(colour = Nest_parasitized,
        shape = Nest_parasitized),
    alpha = 0.7, width = 0.05, height = 0.01, size = 2
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("not parasitized" = "#59989e",
             "parasitized"     = "#21393b"),
    labels = c("Not parasitised", "Parasitised"),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("not parasitized" = "#59989e",
             "parasitized"     = "#21393b"),
    labels = c("Not parasitised", "Parasitised"),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia))
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("not parasitized" = 16,
             "parasitized" = 17),
    labels = c("Not parasitised", "Parasitised"),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia))
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05))


## Megachile ##

# put 'not parasitized' last so it is drawn on top and make proportion data for figure
nesting_investment_meg <- nesting_investment_meg %>%
  mutate(
    Nest_parasitized = factor(Nest_parasitized, 
                              levels = c("parasitized", "not parasitized")),
    Prop_filled = Filled_length / Straw_length
  )

# plot
P3b_meg <- nesting_investment_meg %>%
  filter(!is.na(Nest_parasitized)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(DP_meg_prior, Prop_filled)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm", 
              method.args = list(family = binomial()), 
    aes(colour = Nest_parasitized, 
        fill = Nest_parasitized), 
    linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Nest_parasitized, 
                  shape = Nest_parasitized), 
              alpha = 0.7, width = 0.05, height = 0.1, size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "not parasitized" = "#B6686B",
      "parasitized" = "#422426"
    ),
    breaks = c("not parasitized", "parasitized"),
    labels = c("Not parasitised", "Parasitised"),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "not parasitized" = "#B6686B",
      "parasitized" = "#422426"
    ),
    breaks = c("not parasitized", "parasitized"),
    labels = c("Not parasitised", "Parasitised"),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile))
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "not parasitized" = 16,
      "parasitized" = 17
    ),
    breaks = c("not parasitized", "parasitized"),
    labels = c("Not parasitised", "Parasitised"),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile))
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("0", "1"))


# Combine 
        
combined_p3b <- P3b_os + P3b_meg + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(4, 3), guides = 'collect') 
combined_p3b <- combined_p3b +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

P3b_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Proportion of straw filled with cells',
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) 

P3b_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Number of neighbouring nests with detectable parasites',
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
  
# add left and bottom labels
Fig_p3b <- cowplot::plot_grid(P3b_left_label, combined_p3b, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95)) 
Fig_p3b <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig_p3b, P3b_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))

Fig_p3b

# save
ggsave('Figures/Fig_p3b.png', Fig_p3b, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300) 


```

```{r P3c_Nest_Termination}

## Osmia ##

nesting_cells_os_fig <- nesting_cells_os %>% select(Nest_ID, Cell_ID, Cell_position, Cell_parasitized) 

nesting_cells_os_fig <- nesting_cells_os_fig %>% 
  mutate(Cell_parasitized_word = ifelse(Cell_parasitized == 1, 'Parasitized', 'Not parasitized'))

Fig_p3c_os <- nesting_cells_os_fig %>% 
  filter(Cell_position == 'last cell' | Cell_position == 'not last cell') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Cell_position, fill = Cell_parasitized_word, group = Cell_parasitized_word)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'fill') +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c('Not parasitized' = '#59989e', 'Parasitized' = '#21393b'),
    labels = c('Not parasitised', 'Parasitised'),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia))
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)


## Megachile ##

nesting_cells_meg_fig <- nesting_cells_meg %>% select(Nest_ID, Cell_ID, Cell_position, Cell_parasitized)

nesting_cells_meg_fig <- nesting_cells_meg_fig %>% 
  mutate(Cell_parasitized_word = ifelse(Cell_parasitized == 1, 'Parasitized', 'Not parasitized'))

Fig_p3c_meg <- nesting_cells_meg_fig %>% 
  filter(Cell_position == 'last cell' | Cell_position == 'not last cell') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Cell_position, fill = Cell_parasitized_word, group = Cell_parasitized_word)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'fill') +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c('Not parasitized' = '#B6686B', 'Parasitized' = '#422426'),
    labels = c('Not parasitised', 'Parasitised'),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile))
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)
 


## Combine plots

combined_p3c <-  Fig_p3c_os | Fig_p3c_meg

combined_p3c <- combined_p3c +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

# make lengends stack ontop of each other
combined_p3c <- combined_p3c + plot_layout(guides = 'collect') &
  theme(legend.box = 'vertical') 

Fig_p3c <- combined_p3c + plot_annotation(tag_levels = NULL) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

P3c_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Proportion of cells',
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

P3c_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = 'Cell position',
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
  
# add left and bottom labels
Fig_p3c <- cowplot::plot_grid(P3c_left_label, combined_p3c, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95)) 
Fig_p3c <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig_p3c, P3c_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))

# save
ggsave('Figures/Fig_p3c.png', Fig_p3c, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
